import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long n, k, MOD;
    static int[] factorial = new int[262155];
    static int[] invFactorial = new int[262155];
    static int[][] memo = new int[262155][31];
    static boolean[][] processed = new boolean[262155][31];
    static int[] log2Val = new int[262155];
    static int[] powerCount = new int[262155];
    static List<int[]> seq = new ArrayList<>();

    static void fastRead(DataInputStream in, int[] buffer, int index) throws IOException {
        int v = 0;
        boolean negative = false;
        int c;
        while ((c = in.read()) != -1 && !Character.isDigit(c)) {
            if (c == '-') negative = true;
        }
        do {
            v = (v << 3) + (v << 1) + (c ^ '0');
        } while ((c = in.read()) != -1 && Character.isDigit(c));
        if (negative) v = -v;
        buffer[index] = v;
    }

    static long modExponentiation(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int getPowerOfTwo(int x) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while ((x & 1) == 0 && x != 0) {
            ++cnt;
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static int comb(int N, int M) {
        return (int) (((long) factorial[N] * invFactorial[M] % MOD) * invFactorial[N - M] % MOD);
    }

    static int solveRec(int N, int K) {
        if (N == 0) return 1;
        if (K == 0) return 0;
        if (memo[N][K] != -1) return memo[N][K];
        
        int step = 1 << log2Val[N];
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = N; i >= step; i -= 2) {
            sum = (int) ((sum + (long) comb(N, i) * solveRec(N - i, K - 1) % MOD * K) % MOD);
        }
        return memo[N][K] = sum;
    }

    static int solveIter(int N, int K) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{N, K});
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int curN = cur[0];
            int curK = cur[1];
            seq.add(new int[]{curN, curK});
            
            if (curN == 0 || curK == 0) continue;
            
            int step = 1 << log2Val[curN];
            for (int i = curN; i >= step; i -= 2) {
                if (powerCount[i] + powerCount[curN - i] == powerCount[curN] && !processed[curN - i][curK - 1]) {
                    processed[curN - i][curK - 1] = true;
                    q.add(new int[]{curN - i, curK - 1});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = seq.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            int[] cur = seq.get(i);
            int curN = cur[0];
            int curK = cur[1];
            if (curN == 0) {
                memo[curN][curK] = 1;
                continue;
            }
            if (curK == 0) {
                memo[curN][curK] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            
            int step = 1 << log2Val[curN];
            for (int i = curN; i >= step; i -= 2) {
                if (powerCount[i] + powerCount[curN - i] == powerCount[curN]) {
                    memo[curN][curK] = (int) ((memo[curN][curK] + (long) comb(curN, i) * memo[curN - i][curK - 1] % MOD * curK) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }
        
        return memo[N][K];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        k = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        MOD = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        factorial[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 262155; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 31; ++j) {
                memo[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        log2Val[0] = -1;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= 262150; ++i) {
            factorial[i] = (int) (((long) factorial[i - 1] * i) % MOD);
            log2Val[i] = log2Val[i >> 1] + 1;
            powerCount[i] = powerCount[i - 1] + getPowerOfTwo(i);
        }
        
        invFactorial[262150] = (int) modExponentiation(factorial[262150], MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 262149; i >= 1; --i) {
            invFactorial[i] = (int) (((long) invFactorial[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MOD);
        }
        
        invFactorial[0] = invFactorial[1];
        
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modExponentiation(k, n));
        } else {
            long total = modExponentiation(k, n);
            int result = solveIter((int)n, (int)k);
            long ans = ((total - result) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }
}
